Rainy_Day_0: I'm still not quite used to the sound of the rain pattering the rooftops.$u#$b#I didn't realize how quiet it is underwater until I came to the surface.$s
Rainy_Day_1: A rainy day is the perfect day to stay inside, binge watch a TV show, and crochet.#$b#You know, it would be even better snuggled up in your arms.$l
Rainy_Day_2: Sometimes, I miss the sense of structure and purpose I used to have when I was a soldier.$s#$b#Even now, as a wife, it feels like I'm trying to find myself still.$11#$b#I know I can depend on you to support me, though.
Rainy_Day_3: When Ryden and I were younger, Ryden would always run off to who-knows-where when it was raining on the surface.$u#$b#Man, he's always been weird!$h
Rainy_Day_4: Get some pep in your step, @!$h#$b#So what if it's gloomy outside? You think dark waters ever stopped me from getting up and getting out there?#$b#Don't worry. I'm just teasing.
patio_{{Sonia}}: What? Can't a girl get some sun on her scales every once in a while?$b#You humans spend too much time indoors.$u
Rainy_Night_0: Good grief, @, you're soaked!$7#$b#Although... I don't mind seeing your clothes clinging to your body like that.$l
Rainy_Night_1: Welcome home, dear.$8#$b#What? No, I'm okay. Just thinking about how far we've come, is all.
Rainy_Night_2: When I've been crocheting all day, the pain in my bad wrist flares.$s#$b#It's inconvenient, but... if I hadn't gotten injured, I wouldn't have picked up this hobby at all.
Indoor_Day_0: Hey there, gorgeous.$l#$b#What, you think the lovey-dovey talk is out of character for me? Don't be ridiculous.$17
Indoor_Night_0: Oh, you're finally back!$h#$b#I made some cobbler while you were away.[611]#$b#Yeah, it's a little... tart. Just think about all the love I put into it and that should cover the taste up.$u#$b#I hope.$u
Indoor_Night_1: Somehow, being alone during the day in a quiet farmhouse makes me nostalgic for my lonely little shipwreck down in Malha.$s#$b#Not to say I don't miss you when you're gone, of course!$7#$b#That old shack was nice, but... I prefer being with someone I love.
TwoKids_0: Me and Ryden were both the only merchildren in our families. I have no idea what it's like to have a sibling.$u#$b#I hope that both %kid1 and %kid2 understand that they are loved equally.
TwoKids_2: I never thought I'd have time for one little kid running around, much less two!$h#$b#They're pretty cute, though, aren't they?
Bad_6: @? I don't like being a housewife.$u#$b#I know I can't fight anymore, but surely there's something else I could do other than clean up after your messes all day.$u
spring_12: The Egg Festival is tomorrow, isn't it?#$u#You know, the idea of hunting eggs as a festive tradition has grown on me.#$b#I mean, it's just so ridiculous... how can you not love it?$h
summer_1: Did you know summer was my favorite season when I was younger?#$b#That was, of course, until I started living on the surface...$s#$b#Now it's just so HOT!$6
summer_10: Have you thought about what you're going to put in the potluck soup tomorrow?#$b#I'm so excited - nothing makes me happier than people celebrating the greatness of food!$h
summer_27: Aren't you just so excited for the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies tomorrow?#$b#I loved seeing the moonlight jellies before I met you, but there's something so wonderfully romantic about watching them with the person I love.$l
fall_1: Ah, don't you just love the smell of fallen leaves in autumn?#$b#It's one of the many things I never experienced underwater that I love about dry land.$h
fall_15: I'm so excited for the Fair tomorrow!$h#$b#With all the visitors from afar coming into the Valley, it makes me feel like I'm truly getting a taste of human culture.
fall_26: It's spooky season, my dear! Spirit's Eve is nigh.#$b#No monster in the Valley could ever be as scary as the prospect of a life without you.$l
winter_1: Winter is finally upon us!$h#$b#I'd hate for you to be cold, @... but your cheeks do look quite cute when they're red.$l
winter_7: The Festival of Ice is tomorrow... I assume there will be another ice fishing competition this year, yes?$u#$b#If I was able to transform into a merman in front of the villagers, I could just dive under the ice and absolutely smoke the competition...$h#$b#What a shame.$7
winter_20: It's so cold out... but your presence warms my heart.$l
winter_28: I'm so proud of all the hard work you've done on the farm this year, darling.#$b#Here's to many more!$h
